Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the state parks golden age pass.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state parks golden age pass; and adding anew section to chapter 79A.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall establish a Washington state parks golden agepass that entitles the holder to free access and free use of all stateparks. The pass costs a onetime fee of ten dollars. The pass allowsa senior, and others in their private vehicle, into the park. The commission must adopt rules for the implementation and use ofthe state parks golden age pass. The commission must submit a yearlyreport to the legislature concerning the use and cost of the stateparks golden age pass. For the purposes of this section and rules adopted under thissection, "senior" means a person age sixtytwo or older.
